Remark
[The theorem at the maximal initial scale] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0090 ↗ thm:chow-iii-localized-no-local-collapsing 1. ch18:18.37\group Localized Noncollapsing

For a nonflat flow on $[0,T]$, let $\bar r_0\le \sqrt T$ be the largest radius for which the curvature bound in Theorem 5 holds, and set $A(r_0)=r_0^n/\Vol _{g(0)}B_{g(0)}(x_0,r_0)$. For every $r_0\le \bar r_0$, the theorem gives weak noncollapsing below scale $r_0$ on $B_{g(r_0^2)}(x_0,A(r_0)r_0)$.
